title: Foundry bridge handshake message
description: One message of the handshake on the Core's /foundry WebSocket (docs/contracts/foundry-bridge.md).

oneOf.title: hello
oneOf.description: Sent once by the module in the GM's browser, right after the socket opens.

protocol.description: The protocol version the module implements (semver).

campaign.description: The campaign id stored in the world, or null when the world is not bound.

oneOf.title: welcome
oneOf.description: The Core accepts the connection. The module stores `campaign` in the world.

oneOf.title: refused
oneOf.description: The Core refuses the connection, then closes the socket.

message.description: A message for the GM, in English.
